Question: If you are performing domain adaptation with ZDDA using AlexNet as the base network architecture and $D_F$ as the target domain, which layers of the network would be considered part of the source CNN and which would be part of the source classifier?
Evidence:
[E1] (text, Section 4.2, page 8): We use Caﬀe [24] to implement ZDDA. Table 4 lists the base network architecture (BNA) we use and the layer separating the source/target CNN and the source
[E2] (text, Section 2, page 3): Domain adaptation (DA) has been extensively studied in computer vision and applied to various applications such as image classiﬁcation [1, 14–16, 25, 30, 35, 37,39–41,43,44,47,50], semantic segmentation [45,51], and image captioning [8]. With the advance of deep neural networks in recent years, the state-of-the-art methods successfully perform DA with (fully or partially) labeled [8, 15, 25, 30, 39] or unlabeled [1, 14–16, 35, 37, 39–41, 43–45, 47, 50] T-R target-domain data. Although diﬀerent strategies such as the domain adversarial loss [40] and the domain confusion loss [39] are proposed to improve the performance in the DA tasks, most of the existing methods need the T-R target-domain training data, which can be unavailable in reality. In contrast, we propose ZDDA to learn from the T-I dual-domain pairs without using the T-R target-domain training data. One part of ZDDA includes simulating the target-domain representation using the source-domain data, and similar concepts have been mentioned in [19, 21]. However, both of [19, 21] require the access to the T-R dual-domain training pairs, but ZDDA needs no T-R target-domain data.
[E3] (text, Section 4.1, page 7): For domain adaptation (DA), we validate the eﬃcacy of ZDDA under classiﬁcation tasks using the MNIST [27], Fashion-MNIST [46], NIST [18], EMNIST [9], and SUN RGB-D [36] datasets. For sensor fusion, we experiment on the SUN RGB-D [36] dataset. We summarize the statistics of these datasets in Table 3, where we list the dataset IDs which we use to refer to these datasets. For D M , D F , D N , and D E , we create the colored version of these datasets ( D M -M, D F - M, D N -M, and D E -M) according to the procedure proposed in Ganin’s work [13]

These claims failed the checks; write corrected claims to replace them:
- "The base network architecture (BNA) we use and the layer separating the source/target CNN and the source classifier are listed in Table 4.": the quote is not in E1
- "The source CNN and the source classifier are part of the base network architecture (BNA) used in ZDDA.": the quote is not in E1
- "The layers of the network that are part of the source CNN and the source classifier are not explicitly defined in the given evidence.": the quote is not in E1
